prompt:
Document type: adjuster_file. Page 1 of 2.

<page>
Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Bodily Injury Unit
Claim Notes
Claim number:
C-1009
Claimant:
David May
Adjuster:
Chelsea Hebert
December 5, 2023
Reported a left-turn collision at an intersection this morning. The other driver, who is named on our policy, says they
were struck while the insured was turning across their path.
January 18, 2024
Claimant is represented by counsel, who has asked that all contact go through their office. Sent the acknowledgment
letter and opened a bodily injury file alongside the property damage file.
March 26, 2024
Obtained statements from two independent witnesses, both of whom describe the same sequence of events the
driver gave. Police report confirms the claimant was in the vehicle at the time of impact.
April 15, 2024
Photos from the scene and the vehicles are consistent with the impact described. Damage to the front of the
claimant's car lines up with the other vehicle's rear quarter panel.
April 18, 2024
Estimate is in and the bulk of the damage fits the force of a side impact of this type. Appraiser flagged a structural
area that appears to have been repaired before, and I have asked for the prior repair records.
May 9, 2024
Prior claim history shows an earlier accident to the same vehicle, which was never reported to us or to the prior
carrier. The same major damage appears in the records from that event and is now being presented as new.
May 10, 2024
Spoke with the claimant's attorney, who confirmed the client's account of the crash and provided medical notes. The
claimant has given the same description in every conversation so far, and there is no sign that the coverage period
began after the loss.
June 6, 2024
Medical records describe neck pain and stiffness consistent with whiplash from this kind of impact. No earlier
problems with the same area of the body appear in the records we have.
July 9, 2024
Treatment followed a typical course, with physical therapy tapering off as the claimant improved. The physician's
latest note indiactes the claimant is nearly back to normal and expects to be discharged soon.
July 22, 2024
Reviewing the prior repair records against the current estimate before I make a decision on the property damage. Will
confirm the overlap with the earlier accident with the appraiser and the attorney before setting a settlement position
on either the vehicle or the injury claim.
</page>

Rate each feature below that THIS page gives evidence about. Leave out a feature the page
says nothing about. The ratings are listed from least to most suspicious.
- injury_crash_fit: Does the claimed injury fit the type and force of the crash? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- treatment_growth: Did the treatment grow beyond what this injury needs? Allowed: Normal, Elevated, Disproportionate, Extreme.
- pre_existing_condition: Did an earlier condition of the same body area add to the complaints? Allowed: None, Minor, Material, Predominant.
- occurrence_support: Do independent sources (witnesses, photos, cameras, the other driver) confirm that the accident happened as described? Allowed: Confirmed, Partially corroborated, Uncorroborated, Contradicted, Suspected staged.
- damage_crash_fit: Does the vehicle damage fit the described impact? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- account_stability: Did the claimant's account of the accident stay the same over time? Allowed: Stable, Clarified, Materially changed.
- occupant_presence: Was the claimant really in the vehicle at the time of the crash? Allowed: Verified, Unclear, Added later, Not present.
- prior_damage_evidence: Is there evidence of vehicle damage from before this crash? Allowed: None, Possible, Documented, Material.
- known_loss_evidence: Is there evidence the damage existed or was known before the coverage started? Allowed: Weak, Moderate, Strong.
- driver_status: Is the driver of the insured vehicle on the policy? Allowed: Listed, Household, Unlisted, Excluded.

For each rated feature give:
- "rating": exactly one of the allowed ratings,
- "confidence": "High", "Medium" or "Low" (how clearly the page shows it),
- "quote": one or two sentences copied EXACTLY from the page that support the rating, with any
  spelling errors as they are,
- "reason": one short sentence.
